Systems Integration: Architect seamless integration layers to bridge contemporary front-end implementations with deeply rooted, foundational backend systems. Infrastructure Management: Deploy and manage applications in Linux environments, utilizing Nginx and efficient shell scripting to ensure optimal system performance.
